tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground behind every sheet and the rail.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: A raised sheet (yours), the Activity drawer, inputs, a chosen option, the Ask panel.

tokens.name: sheet-2
tokens.usage: Inner panels inside a sheet, the Ask composer, a waiting button.

tokens.name: flat
tokens.usage: A flat sheet: what is not yours. Always with the shadow-ring hairline.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The track a segmented control's options sit in, a checked toggle.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings. 14.5:1 on bg, 17.3:1 on sheet, 15.9:1 on flat.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, reasons after a state, plain links. 6.6:1 on bg, 7.9:1 on sheet.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: column heads, ids, since lines. 5.1:1 on sheet, 4.7:1 on flat and sheet-2. Only 4.3:1 on bg: keep it on a sheet.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: a flat sheet's ring, control rings, the rail's chosen item. 1.4:1 on sheet: a hairline, not a control border that must be found.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Faint dividers, the neutral tag ground, the base of a due lane.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The table grid: 1px dashes, 10px period, open at every edge. Decorative only.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The neutral edge on a marked row that is not yours, the radio ring. 2.4:1 on sheet: below 3:1, keep a word or a position beside it.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: A table row under the pointer.

tokens.name: hover-row
tokens.usage: A clickable row under the pointer.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: The ring around a step dot under the pointer.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind an open drawer.

tokens.name: you
tokens.usage: What is yours: the one action, Needs you, your row's edge, focus rings. 6.1:1 on sheet, 5.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: you-soft
tokens.usage: Behind you text: Your task now, your row in the Activity drawer, an action card's button at rest. you on you-soft is 5.2:1.

tokens.name: on-you
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a you fill. 6.1:1.

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: The pulse around the current step when it is yours.

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: Stopped: nothing can move until someone acts. 5.2:1 on sheet.

tokens.name: stop-soft
tokens.usage: Behind stop text in chips and tags. stop on stop-soft is 4.2:1, under 4.5: keep that text 12px semibold or larger.

tokens.name: stop-deep
tokens.usage: A plan bar segment that counts stopped work and carries no label.

tokens.name: risk
tokens.usage: At risk or late: still moving, but behind. Also Medium risk. 5.0:1 on sheet.

tokens.name: risk-soft
tokens.usage: Behind risk text. risk on risk-soft is 4.4:1, under 4.5: keep that text 12px semibold or larger.

tokens.name: risk-deep
tokens.usage: A plan bar segment that counts at-risk work and carries no label.

tokens.name: work
tokens.usage: Madison working: the only state that moves. 6.5:1 on sheet.

tokens.name: work-soft
tokens.usage: Behind work text: the in-progress plan segment, the Ask mark. work on work-soft is 5.5:1.

tokens.name: work-deep
tokens.usage: A plan bar segment that counts work in progress and carries no label.

tokens.name: wait
tokens.usage: Waiting on someone else. Also Low risk. 6.1:1 on sheet.

tokens.name: wait-soft
tokens.usage: Behind wait text: the Low risk pill, a waiting plan segment. 5.3:1.

tokens.name: wait-deep
tokens.usage: A plan bar segment that counts waiting work and carries no label.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: On time, Confirmed covered. A green set apart from the you teal. 5.2:1 on sheet.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Behind ok text in the plan bar. ok on ok-soft is 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ok-deep
tokens.usage: A plan bar segment that counts confirmed work and carries no label.

tokens.name: level-high
tokens.usage: High risk text and its signal bars. 4.5:1 on level-high-soft.

tokens.name: level-high-soft
tokens.usage: Behind High risk.

tokens.name: sel
tokens.usage: A checked cell in a joined yes/no control inside a table.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: A finished step dot and a finished step dot in a row of dots.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Madison in the rail. Set in type: there is no logo file.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: A record's title in its page header.

styles.name: task-title
styles.usage: The title of your task inside its sheet.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: A plan's big number.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: An action card's title.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: A sheet's title row, a column head on the Actions board.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: An action card's line, the person's name in the rail (600).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Table cells, label and value rows, drawer rows.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: A row's subject when it is yours, step names.

styles.name: message
styles.sample: Section 3 sets who may authorise a transfer.
styles.usage: Ask Madison's answers and your questions.

styles.name: nav-item
styles.usage: An item in the rail's live section. 600 when it is the page you are on.

styles.name: nav-item-quiet
styles.usage: An item in a rail section you are not in.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Since lines, header metadata, plain links, reasons.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: A step's sub line.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Rail section names, drawer section names. Uppercase.

styles.name: column-head
styles.usage: Table column heads, in ink-3. Uppercase.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary and secondary buttons (secondary at 600).

styles.name: button-small
styles.usage: Small buttons, a chosen segmented option (an option at rest is 400).

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Filter chips, state labels in tables, risk pills.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tags: Your task now, View only, Stopped.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Ids beside a name: controls, wires, runs. Dates in a due lane.

styles.name: id-small
styles.usage: Ids in a table, dates in the drawer, the Ask key.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: Counts in a badge and a chip.

tokens.name: space-rail
tokens.usage: The rail's width. The page frame starts at 230px (rail plus space-page-left).

tokens.name: space-page-top
tokens.usage: Above the first thing on a page.

tokens.name: space-page-left
tokens.usage: Between the rail and the content.

tokens.name: space-page-right
tokens.usage: Right of the content: leaves room for the drawer tab.

tokens.name: space-page-bottom
tokens.usage: Below the content: clears the Ask Madison bar.

tokens.name: space-panel-gap
tokens.usage: Between the sheets on a page, top to bottom.

tokens.name: space-panel-y
tokens.usage: A sheet's padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-panel-x
tokens.usage: A sheet's padding left and right. Every text line inside a sheet starts here, tables included.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: An action card's padding, all sides.

tokens.name: space-grid
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-columns
tokens.usage: Between the columns of the Actions board.

tokens.name: space-cell-x
tokens.usage: A table cell's padding left and right. The outer cells take 0 on their outside, so the table sits on the sheet's text line.

tokens.name: space-cell-y
tokens.usage: A table cell's padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-row-y
tokens.usage: A list row's padding top and bottom: a table whose rows open records.

tokens.name: space-chip-x
tokens.usage: A chip's padding left and right.

tokens.name: space-button-x
tokens.usage: A button's padding left and right.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: A chip's height.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: A button's height. The standard.

tokens.name: size-button-card
tokens.usage: A button inside an action card.

tokens.name: size-button-small
tokens.usage: A small secondary button, a segmented option.

tokens.name: size-row-home
tokens.usage: A row in a Home table.

tokens.name: size-calendar-row
tokens.usage: A row in a calendar.

tokens.name: size-step-dot
tokens.usage: A step dot that is done, late or still to come.

tokens.name: size-step-current
tokens.usage: The current step's dot.

tokens.name: size-drawer
tokens.usage: The Activity drawer's width.

tokens.name: size-ask
tokens.usage: The Ask Madison bar, closed.

tokens.name: size-ask-open
tokens.usage: The Ask Madison panel, open.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets, action cards, done items.

tokens.name: radius-drawer
tokens.usage: The Activity drawer, the open Ask panel.

tokens.name: radius-ask
tokens.usage: The closed Ask Madison bar.

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: An inner panel inside a sheet.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Chips (half their height), option cards, the hover preview, the empty state.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Text inputs, selects, textareas. Rail items.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Tags: Your task now, View only, Stopped.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: A calendar row's hover ground.

tokens.name: radius-toggle
tokens.usage: A small toggle chip (1 2 3 4 5).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented tracks and options, risk pills.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A raised sheet: what is yours. An action card under the pointer.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Under the one primary button.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The open Activity drawer. None when it is closed.

tokens.name: shadow-stop
tokens.usage: A stopped sheet: raised, ringed in stop.

tokens.name: shadow-ring
tokens.usage: The hairline of a flat sheet, a chip, an input, a secondary button.

tokens.name: shadow-selected
tokens.usage: A chosen segmented option.

tokens.name: shadow-chip-selected
tokens.usage: A chosen filter chip (All 7).

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: A pill button under the pointer.

tokens.name: shadow-peek
tokens.usage: The hover preview card.

tokens.name: shadow-ask
tokens.usage: The closed Ask Madison bar.

tokens.name: shadow-ask-open
tokens.usage: The open Ask Madison panel.

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Row and option hovers.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Button colour, lift and press.

tokens.name: duration-lift
tokens.usage: An action card lifting.

tokens.name: duration-appear
tokens.usage: A page's content fading in.

tokens.name: duration-drawer
tokens.usage: The drawer sliding in and out.

tokens.name: duration-ask
tokens.usage: The Ask panel opening.

tokens.name: duration-spin
tokens.usage: One turn of the Madison working icon, counter-clockwise, linear.

tokens.name: duration-ring
tokens.usage: One turn of the dashed ring on Madison's current step.

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: The pulse on your current step.

tokens.name: duration-flow
tokens.usage: The dashes flowing into the current step.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every hover, lift and appear.

tokens.name: ease-drawer
tokens.usage: The drawer.

tokens.name: z-ask
tokens.usage: The Ask Madison bar.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: The scrim behind a drawer.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: A closed drawer.

tokens.name: z-drawer-open
tokens.usage: An open drawer, above the Ask bar.

tokens.name: z-peek
tokens.usage: The hover preview card.
